history.value: Atomico was founded in London in 2006 by Skype co-founder Niklas Zennström. Its early bets included Rovio, Supercell, Klarna and Truecaller, and it later backed Stripe, Hinge Health and DeepL, investing mostly from Series A onward. In 2024 it closed $1.24 billion across two funds, Atomico Venture VI and Atomico Growth VI.
history.basis: Founded in London in 2006 by Niklas Zennström (the firm's own posts; Skype co-founder). Early bets per the firm's own 2017 fund post ('we've partnered with ... Klarna, Rovio, Supercell, The Climate Corporation, GoEuro and Skype') and the portfolio rows: Rovio Series A 2011, Klarna 2012, Supercell 2013 secondary, Truecaller Series C 2014; later Stripe (CMS 2015), Hinge Health Series A 2017 (IPO 2025), DeepL (CMS 2023). 'Investing mostly from Series A onward': 'Since inception we've partnered with founders from series A, expanding to include growth investments in 2011' (2024 fund post). Fund VI: $754M Growth VI and $485M Venture VI, $1.24B (2024-09-09). Dropped to fit: the fund ladder ($165M 2010, $476M 2013, $765M 2017, $820M 2020, see funds), the State of European Tech report, offices

investment_concept.value: “Capital is a commodity. Experience is not.”
investment_concept.basis: The firm's own statement, verbatim from the homepage's lead heading (h2), read from the Common Crawl capture of atomico.com of 2026-01-18 (https://index.commoncrawl.org/CC-MAIN-2026-04-index?url=atomico.com/&output=json) (local copy scratch/site-raw/home-cc20260118051330.html) because the live site sits behind a bot checkpoint; published inside quotation marks as the firm's words. Competing lines on the same page: the h1 is a banner for the firm's '2025 State of European Tech' report, and the meta description reads 'Atomico invests in innovative technology companies around the world.'

investment_stage.basis: entry stages on the 165-row base after classification: Series A 56, Growth 48, Seed 18, undetermined 41 (2 unnameable); the firm's own framing: 'predominantly at Series A, alongside occasional Seed opportunities' (Venture VI) and 'from Series B to pre-IPO' (Growth VI), 2024 fund post

investment_geo.basis: hq_country on the classified base: 103 of 165 in Europe (GB 45, DE 15, NL 7, SE 6, ES 5, FI 5, FR 4, CH 4, others), US 45, elsewhere 17 (mostly the 2011-2012 Latin America and Asia deals: CN, JP, RU, BR, AR, UY), 2 unnameable; the CMS location filter is Europe by region plus 'USA' and 'Rest of World'

investment_scope.basis: focus from the firm's own site sector tags on 146 base rows, crosswalked to data/taxonomy/focus.json (crosswalk in config.json), published above 8 companies. Scope type is the curated judgement carried in investor.json.

investment_range.basis: Median: the entry round on 122 portfolio rows whose recorded funding_rounds give a size (the first round the firm joined): median $17.25M, p25 $10.0M, p75 $51.5M, p90 $115.5M, published as $17M; the rounds are co-invested, so this is a round-size proxy for check size. | Lower limit: the smallest entry rounds are 2011-era seeds of $0.5M-$1M (Silk EUR 320K, Restorando $500K, Quipper GBP 400K, Siine GBP 550K, EVRYTHNG $1M), published as $1M. | Upper limit: the largest rounds the firm led or co-led at entry are TravelPerk $200M (2025, with EQT), PsiQuantum $150M (2020), CodeRabbit $143M (2026, with Smash) and PhysicsX $135M (2025); a 10-15% single-position concentration of the largest fund ($820M, Atomico V) gives $82M-$123M, so $100M. Rejected: The Exploration Company's $450M (three co-leads, the firm's share unknown)

notable_investments.basis: The five best known of the firm's own companies, most recognised first: the names a general reader would recognise first (PRO-152, Erik 2026-09-24); names as a reader knows them (COLLECTION.md §8). Also considered: Rovio (Angry Birds), MasterClass, Truecaller, Hinge Health, Zocdoc.

funds.basis: The firm's own fund announcements (2013, 2017, 2020, 2024) and TechCrunch for 2010; the ADV 7.B roster confirms III, IV, V, Venture VI and Growth VI. hq_location.basis: Principal office on the newest Form ADV: 29-35 Rathbone Street, London, United Kingdom (ATOMICO (UK) PARTNERS LLP, CRD 301113, Annual Amendment filed 2026-06-08).
